worksOnSalesforce.title: Works on Salesforce: 100% Native Architecture
worksOnSalesforce.text: EstateForce is built 100% natively on Salesforce Lightning platform. Unlike third-party real estate CRMs that require external databases, APIs, or data synchronizers, all your property inventory, lead communications, and financial milestones reside securely within your own Salesforce organization. Your team accesses the entire system directly from the official Salesforce Mobile App on iOS and Android with zero additional installations. Benefit from Salesforce enterprise-grade encryption, role-based sharing hierarchies, automated package updates, and seamless compatibility with your existing Sales Cloud and Service Cloud configurations.

securityAndFitPage.pageIntroduction: Enterprise-grade architecture, native data sovereignty, and security governance designed for Salesforce administrators, infosec reviewers, and IT directors.
securityAndFitPage.fitAndDataText: EstateForce is built 100% natively on the Salesforce Lightning platform. Unlike hybrid real estate CRMs that synchronize confidential buyer details, unit inventory, and payment receipts to third-party cloud servers or offshore MongoDB instances, EstateForce executes entirely within your existing Salesforce multi-tenant trust boundary. All custom objects (Projects, Towers, Units, Holds, Bookings, CLP Milestones) reside inside your organization's dedicated database schema. Your property data never leaves Salesforce, ensuring total compliance with your corporate infosec mandates, RERA statutory audit policies, and ISO 27001 data protection protocols.
securityAndFitPage.accessAndProtectionText: EstateForce inherits the full enterprise security infrastructure of Salesforce. User permissions are strictly enforced through packaged Permission Sets and your existing Role Hierarchies. Field-level security prevents sales executives from seeing confidential margin discounts, while allowing finance teams full visibility into milestone cash collections. EstateForce is fully compatible with Salesforce Shield Platform Encryption for encryption-at-rest across sensitive buyer fields (mobile numbers, PAN, bank details). All transactions are recorded in the standard Salesforce Setup Audit Trail and custom object Field History Tracking for tamper-proof compliance auditing.
installationSteps: 1. Install the managed package from Salesforce AppExchange into your Sandbox environment.

3. Configure Project Towers, Unit Inventory typologies, and CLP milestone schedules in EstateForce Setup.
4. Test 60-minute holding locks, portal API webhooks, and push change sets to Production with confidence.

pricingFaqs.question: Are there any minimum user seat requirements?
pricingFaqs.answer: Starter Edition requires a minimum of 5 users, while Growth and Enterprise Editions require a minimum of 10 users. Additional user licenses can be added at any time pro-rata.

pricingFaqs.question: Does this price include the underlying Salesforce license?
pricingFaqs.answer: No. EstateForce is an AppExchange Managed Package that installs directly into your existing Salesforce Enterprise, Unlimited, or Performance org. You bring your standard Salesforce licenses, and our package operates 100% natively on top.

pricingFaqs.question: Are implementation and data migration fees included?
pricingFaqs.answer: Standard onboarding configuration and sandbox package installation are included in all annual plans. Complex legacy CRM data migrations or custom portal webhook builds are quoted transparently during your initial demo scoping.

pricingFaqs.question: Can we upgrade or downgrade plans between project phases?
pricingFaqs.answer: Yes. Real estate development is cyclical. You can upgrade from Starter to Growth when launching a new tower, or expand to Enterprise for township rollouts with seamless license adjustments.

pricingFaqs.question: What payment terms and currencies are supported?
pricingFaqs.answer: We support annual invoicing in INR (₹) with standard GST invoices for Indian entities, as well as USD ($) wire transfers for international developers.

contactForPricing.message: Pricing for custom township developments and multi-state brokerages depends on active unit volume and team size. Request a guided demo to receive a customized quote.

faqPage.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subheadline: Everything you need to know about the EstateForce native Salesforce package, technical prerequisites, data migration, and pricing.

faqs.question: How does EstateForce prevent inventory double-bookings during busy launch days?
faqs.answer: EstateForce employs atomic Apex record locks with a 60-second token timeout. When a sales executive holds a unit on their mobile or tablet, the unit immediately turns orange across all team members' matrices. If booking advance isn't submitted within 60 seconds, the lock automatically releases back to inventory.

faqs.question: Can EstateForce manage both residential apartments and commercial retail leases?
faqs.answer: Yes. EstateForce includes dedicated object record types for residential units (BHK, super area, floor rise, parking) and commercial properties (carpet area, CAM charges, fit-out rent-free periods, and escalation clauses).

faqs.question: How does Construction-Linked Plan (CLP) milestone billing work?
faqs.answer: When a project engineer marks a construction slab complete in Salesforce, EstateForce automatically generates compliant demand notices with computerized interest calculations, attaching Razorpay or UPI payment links sent to unit owners via WhatsApp and email.

faqs.question: Which Salesforce editions are required to run EstateForce?
faqs.answer: EstateForce supports Salesforce Enterprise Edition, Unlimited Edition, and Performance Edition. It runs seamlessly on Sales Cloud or Service Cloud orgs.

faqs.question: Is EstateForce 100% native on the Salesforce platform?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100% native. All customer leads, unit inventory tables, price books, and financial transactions reside strictly inside your Salesforce database. No data is mirrored or stored on external third-party proprietary servers.

faqs.question: How long does a standard implementation take from kickoff to go-live?
faqs.answer: A turnkey deployment typically takes 14 business days: Day 1-3 sandbox package installation and custom object setup, Day 4-7 data migration and pricing rules, Day 8-10 role-based staff training, and Day 11-14 production cutover with hypercare.

faqs.question: Do our sales executives require specialized technical Salesforce certifications to use it?
faqs.answer: Not at all. The field interface is built with simplified Lightning Web Components tailored for mobile browsers and tablets, allowing relationship managers to lock units and log site visits in under 60 seconds.

faqs.question: Can we import existing property leads and past customer records from Excel or legacy ERPs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our onboarding engineers provide pre-mapped CSV migration templates with automatic phone normalization (+91 formatting) and fuzzy deduplication matching.

faqs.question: Are there hidden onboarding fees, user surcharges, or data egress fees?
faqs.answer: No hidden fees. Package licensing is transparently priced per active user with annual billing discounts. Unlimited inventory units, projects, and leads are included across all plans.

faqs.question: Does EstateForce comply with RERA data retention and audit regulations?
faqs.answer: Yes. All inventory status changes, pricing approvals, and milestone demand letters generate permanent Salesforce Field Audit Trails compliant with RERA Section 11 and Section 13 audit standards.

faqs.question: What customer support and maintenance is provided after deployment?
faqs.answer: All subscriptions include standard email and phone ticketing with 4-hour initial SLA. Growth and Enterprise plans receive dedicated Salesforce Solutions Architects, quarterly AppExchange version upgrades, and emergency WhatsApp hotline access.
